newsitem.title: INDIA: India ITC seeks approval to diversify.
newsitem.headline: India ITC seeks approval to diversify.

text.p: Indian tobacco and hotel firm ITC Ltd plans to venture into several new business areas, the company said in a notice to shareholders ahead of its annual general meeting next month.
The company said in the notice obtained by Reuters on Friday that it proposed to move a special resolution at the meeting on August 27 to permit the company to start new businesses.

The new businesses proposed involve trading and manufacture in leather, rubber, clothes, sports gear and apparels, travel accessories, personal accessories, sports accessories, fashion garments, boots, gloves and hosiery, the notice said.
"In evaluating your company's future prospects and plans, your directors have been examining a number of projects for further diversification," the notice said.
It said diversification into new areas of business would need a special resolution to amend the objectives of the company stated in its memorandum of association.

The notice said that company would also seek shareholder approval for "the business of importing, exporting, distributing, trading dealing or manufacturing all kinds of furnitures, handicrafts, showpieces, decorative items and like goods of any description, made from wood, brass, steel, earthware, glass, china, crystal, caneware, fibre glass, plastics, metals or any other alloys or materials and wood fittings."
A company spokeswoman said the projects had not yet been crystalised and the special resolution would be moved to keep future options open.
" These are things of the future and we are keeping our options open. The projects are yet to be chalked out," she said.
